title: Saving Too Much in Your 401k Creates a $400K Tax Bomb
hook: You maxed your 401k for decades thinking you were winning — but the IRS built a mandatory withdrawal rule that could cost you $400,000 in taxes you never planned for.
angle: Contrarian: the very thing you were told to do (max your 401k) creates a hidden tax trap in retirement through Required Minimum Distributions, Medicare surcharges, and SS taxation
audience: Diligent savers in their 40s-60s who've been maxing traditional 401k contributions and don't know about RMD tax traps
key_numbers: Up to 85% of Social Security becomes taxable
